blocks.zh: §4.1–4.3：定義、組合產品類型與適用法規
blocks.en: §§4.1-4.3: Definitions, Combination Product Types, and Applicable Regulations

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 準確說明 21 CFR Part 4 的適用範圍，以及哪類組合產品不在其管轄之內（§4.1）
blocks.en: Accurately describe the scope of 21 CFR Part 4 and which combination products fall outside its jurisdiction (§4.1)

blocks.zh: 掌握組合產品的法定定義與四種類型（單一實體、共包裝、交叉標示、試驗性），以及「主要作用模式（PMOA）」如何決定主管中心（§4.2）
blocks.en: Understand the legal definition of a combination product and its four types (single-entity, co-packaged, cross-labeled, investigational), and how the primary mode of action (PMOA) determines the lead center (§4.2)

blocks.zh: 正確判斷組合產品適用哪套 CGMP 法規——依據組成成分（藥品、器材、生物製品）選擇 21 CFR 210/211、820 或 600s（§4.3）
blocks.en: Correctly determine which CGMP regulations apply to a combination product: choose 21 CFR 210/211, 820, or 600s according to the constituent parts (drug, device, biological product) (§4.3)

blocks.zh: 分析具體產品（預填充式注射器、藥物洗脫支架、mAb 自動注射器等）的組成成分，並建立 CGMP 合規矩陣
blocks.en: Analyze the constituent parts of specific products (prefilled syringes, drug-eluting stents, mAb autoinjectors, etc.) and build a CGMP compliance matrix

blocks.zh: 區分 CDER、CDRH、CBER 三個 FDA 中心在核准途徑、CGMP 標準、變更申報與上市後監控上的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Distinguish the key differences among the three FDA centers (CDER, CDRH, CBER) in approval pathways, CGMP standards, change reporting, and postmarket surveillance

blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 1.1 §4.1 — What Does This Part Cover?（Part 4 的適用範圍）
blocks.en: 1.1 §4.1 — What Does This Part Cover?

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: §4.1 三個核心功能
blocks.en: The Three Core Functions of §4.1

blocks.zh: Part 4 只做三件事，但每件都至關重要：
blocks.en: Part 4 does only three things, but each one is critical:

blocks.zh: 指派主管中心（Assignment）： 決定由 CDER、CDRH 或 CBER 哪個中心主導審查
blocks.en: Assignment of the lead center: determines which center (CDER, CDRH, or CBER) leads the review

blocks.zh: 釐清 CGMP 適用性： 確認製造商應遵循哪套 CGMP（或哪幾套同時適用）
blocks.en: Clarification of CGMP applicability: confirms which CGMP (or which several together) a manufacturer must follow

blocks.zh: 提供合規效率框架： 允許製造商協商整合式 CGMP 合規路徑（詳見 §4.4）
blocks.en: A framework for compliance efficiency: allows manufacturers to negotiate an integrated CGMP compliance path (see §4.4)

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品只是藥品、只是器材、或只是生物製品，Part 4 對你不適用。Part 4 專門解決「跨類別」產品的監管困境。
blocks.en: If your product is only a drug, only a device, or only a biological product, Part 4 does not apply to you. Part 4 exists specifically to resolve the regulatory dilemma of "cross-category" products.

blocks.zh: 重要排除：純 PHS Act 生物製品
blocks.en: Key Exclusion: Biological Products Regulated Solely Under the PHS Act

blocks.zh: §4.1(b) 規定：若某生物製品僅受 PHS Act 管轄，且不含藥品或器材組成成分，則不適用 Part 4。
blocks.en: §4.1(b) provides that if a biological product is subject only to the PHS Act and contains no drug or device constituent part, Part 4 does not apply.

blocks.zh: 實務意義：大多數疫苗、血液製品本身就有藥品特性，通常仍適用 Part 4。只有非常少數「純生物性」製品（如某些血液成分）才享有此排除。
blocks.en: Practical meaning: most vaccines and blood products have drug characteristics themselves and are usually still subject to Part 4. Only a very small number of "purely biological" products (such as certain blood components) benefit from this exclusion.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Quick Check
blocks.en: Quick Check

blocks.zh: 下列哪種情況 Part 4 不適用？
blocks.en: In which of the following situations does Part 4 not apply?

blocks.zh: 含有藥物塗層的心血管導管
blocks.en: A cardiovascular catheter with a drug coating

blocks.zh: 預填充式胰島素筆（筆身為器材，胰島素為藥品）
blocks.en: A prefilled insulin pen (the pen body is a device, the insulin is a drug)

blocks.zh: 只以 PHS Act 管轄、不含任何藥品/器材成分的血液製品
blocks.en: A blood product regulated only under the PHS Act and containing no drug or device constituent part

blocks.zh: 搭配注射裝置使用的單株抗體（mAb）
blocks.en: A monoclonal antibody (mAb) used with an injection device

blocks.zh: 答案：(3)。其餘三種都是典型的組合產品，均適用 Part 4。
blocks.en: Answer: (3). The other three are typical combination products and are all subject to Part 4.

blocks.zh: 1.2 §4.2 — Key Definitions（關鍵定義）
blocks.en: 1.2 §4.2 — Key Definitions

blocks.zh: 組合產品的四種類型（§3.2(e)）
blocks.en: The Four Types of Combination Products (§3.2(e))

blocks.zh: 理解組合產品最重要的是知道「哪種情況構成組合產品」：
blocks.en: The most important thing in understanding combination products is knowing "which situations constitute a combination product":

blocks.zh: 類型 1 — 單一實體（Single-entity）： 藥品與器材在物理或化學上結合為一體，無法分離使用。例：藥物洗脫支架（DES）、抗菌塗層導管
blocks.en: Type 1: Single-entity: the drug and device are physically or chemically combined into one and cannot be used separately. Examples: drug-eluting stents (DES), antimicrobial-coated catheters

blocks.zh: 類型 2 — 共包裝（Co-packaged）： 分開的藥品和器材放在同一個包裝盒內。例：含注射器的胰島素套組、含針頭的預填充注射器套裝
blocks.en: Type 2: Co-packaged: a separate drug and device are placed in the same package. Examples: an insulin kit that includes a syringe, a prefilled syringe set that includes needles

blocks.zh: 類型 3 — 交叉標示（Cross-labeled）： 分開包裝、分開銷售，但標示上明確指定必須搭配特定的另一種產品使用，且缺少另一種就無法達到預期用途。例：某種需配合特定基因檢測才能用的標靶治療藥物
blocks.en: Type 3: Cross-labeled: packaged separately and sold separately, but the labeling specifies that they must be used with a particular other product, and the intended use cannot be achieved without the other product. Example: a targeted therapy that can be used only with a specific genetic test

blocks.zh: 類型 4 — 試驗性（Investigational）： 在臨床試驗中，分開包裝的試驗用藥品/器材/生物製品，依據試驗計畫必須搭配另一種試驗性產品使用
blocks.en: Type 4: Investigational: in a clinical trial, separately packaged investigational drugs/devices/biological products that, under the trial protocol, must be used with another investigational product

blocks.zh: Constituent Part（組成成分）是 Part 4 特有術語，指構成組合產品的藥品、器材或生物製品「本身」。
blocks.en: Constituent part is a term specific to Part 4. It refers to the drug, device, or biological product "itself" that makes up the combination product.

blocks.zh: 注意：不要與 21 CFR Part 820 的「Component（零件/原料）」混淆。
blocks.en: Note: do not confuse it with "component" (a part or raw material) in 21 CFR Part 820.

blocks.zh: 預填充式注射器的「constituent parts」= 藥品（API 及製劑）+ 注射器（器材）
blocks.en: The "constituent parts" of a prefilled syringe = the drug (API and drug product) + the syringe (device)

blocks.zh: 注射器的「components」= 針頭、活塞、玻璃管等零件
blocks.en: The "components" of the syringe = needle, plunger, glass barrel, and other parts

blocks.zh: 這個區分在查廠時非常重要——FDA 調查員會分別評估每個 constituent part 的 CGMP 合規性。
blocks.en: This distinction is very important during inspections: FDA investigators assess the CGMP compliance of each constituent part separately.

blocks.zh: 主要作用模式（PMOA）——決定主管中心的關鍵
blocks.en: Primary Mode of Action (PMOA): The Key to Determining the Lead Center

blocks.zh: PMOA 決定哪個 FDA 中心主導（Lead Center）：
blocks.en: PMOA determines which FDA center takes the lead (Lead Center):

blocks.zh: PMOA = 藥理作用（pharmacological）→ CDER 主導
blocks.en: PMOA = pharmacological action → CDER leads

blocks.zh: PMOA = 器械/物理作用（mechanical/physical）→ CDRH 主導
blocks.en: PMOA = mechanical/physical action of a device → CDRH leads

blocks.zh: PMOA = 生物作用（biological/immunological）→ CBER 主導
blocks.en: PMOA = biological/immunological action → CBER leads

blocks.zh: 難點：若 PMOA 科學上無法確定，OCP 依 §3.4(b) 採用「最嚴格監管」原則指派主管中心。
blocks.en: Difficulty: if the PMOA cannot be determined scientifically, OCP assigns the lead center under §3.4(b) using the "most stringent regulation" principle.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：PMOA 就像車輛的主要功能
blocks.en: Analogy: PMOA Is Like the Main Function of a Vehicle

blocks.zh: 想像一輛「含 GPS 導航的電動車」：
blocks.en: Imagine an "electric car with GPS navigation":

blocks.zh: GPS 是一種功能，但它不是最重要的功能——你買車是為了交通，不是為了導航
blocks.en: GPS is one function, but it is not the most important one: you buy a car for transportation, not for navigation

blocks.zh: 最重要的功能（PMOA）= 電動推進系統
blocks.en: The most important function (PMOA) = the electric propulsion system

blocks.zh: → 因此應由「交通部（相當於 CDRH 或 CDER）」主導監管，而非「衛星通訊主管機關」
blocks.en: → So regulation should be led by the "transportation authority" (equivalent to CDRH or CDER), not by the "satellite communications authority"

blocks.zh: 同理，藥物洗脫支架的 PMOA：雖然含藥物，但最重要的治療效果來自物理支撐開通動脈（器械作用）→ CDRH 主導。
blocks.en: Likewise for the PMOA of a drug-eluting stent: although it contains a drug, the most important therapeutic effect comes from physically propping the artery open (a device action) → CDRH leads.

blocks.zh: OCP 設在 FDA Commissioner 辦公室（非 CDER/CDRH/CBER 轄下），是組合產品監管的仲裁中心：
blocks.en: OCP is located in the Office of the FDA Commissioner (not under CDER/CDRH/CBER) and is the arbitration center for combination product regulation:

blocks.zh: 接受 Request for Designation (RFD) 申請
blocks.en: Receives Request for Designation (RFD) submissions

blocks.zh: 60 天內發出指派決定
blocks.en: Issues a designation decision within 60 days

blocks.zh: 解決各中心對主管權的爭議
blocks.en: Resolves disputes among the centers over jurisdiction

blocks.zh: 監督跨中心的監管一致性
blocks.en: Oversees regulatory consistency across centers

blocks.zh: 實務建議：若不確定產品是否為組合產品或該由哪個中心審查，優先向 OCP 提交 RFD，而非直接向各中心送件。
blocks.en: Practical advice: if you are unsure whether a product is a combination product or which center should review it, submit an RFD to OCP first rather than sending the submission directly to the centers.

blocks.zh: 1.3 §4.3 — Which CGMP Regulations Apply?（適用的 CGMP 法規）
blocks.en: 1.3 §4.3 — Which CGMP Regulations Apply?

blocks.zh: §4.3 的核心邏輯：成分決定法規
blocks.en: The Core Logic of §4.3: Constituent Parts Determine the Regulations

blocks.zh: §4.3 的運作邏輯非常直接：
blocks.en: The logic of §4.3 is very straightforward:

blocks.zh: 含藥品組成成分 → 21 CFR Parts 210 & 211（藥品 CGMP）
blocks.en: Contains a drug constituent part → 21 CFR Parts 210 & 211 (drug CGMP)

blocks.zh: 含器材組成成分 → 21 CFR Part 820（QSR/QMSR）
blocks.en: Contains a device constituent part → 21 CFR Part 820 (QSR/QMSR)

blocks.zh: 含生物製品組成成分 → 21 CFR Parts 600–680
blocks.en: Contains a biological product constituent part → 21 CFR Parts 600-680

blocks.zh: 含 HCT/P 組成成分 → 21 CFR Part 1271
blocks.en: Contains an HCT/P constituent part → 21 CFR Part 1271

blocks.zh: 含多種組成成分 → 同時適用所有相關 CGMP
blocks.en: Contains multiple constituent parts → all relevant CGMP apply at the same time

blocks.zh: 最重要的認知：「主要作用模式是器材」並不代表你只需遵守 Part 820——只要含有藥品成分，21 CFR 211 也必須遵守。
blocks.en: The most important thing to recognize: "the primary mode of action is the device" does not mean you only need to follow Part 820. As long as there is a drug constituent part, 21 CFR 211 must also be followed.

blocks.zh: 常見陷阱：預填充式注射器「只是藥品」？
blocks.en: Common Pitfall: Is a Prefilled Syringe "Just a Drug"?

blocks.zh: 這是業界最常見的誤解之一。
blocks.en: This is one of the most common misconceptions in the industry.

blocks.zh: 預填充式注射器（Pre-filled Syringe）的組成成分：
blocks.en: Constituent parts of a prefilled syringe:

blocks.zh: 藥品（API + 製劑）→ 21 CFR 211 必須適用
blocks.en: Drug (API + formulation) → 21 CFR 211 must apply

blocks.zh: 注射器本身（器材）→ 21 CFR 820 也必須適用
blocks.en: The syringe itself (device) → 21 CFR 820 must also apply

blocks.zh: 很多藥廠的品保人員只熟悉 Part 211，誤以為只要符合藥品 CGMP 就夠了。FDA 查廠時，調查員會同時評估器材組成成分的 Part 820 合規性——包括設計管制（Design Controls）、針頭安全設計（如適用）、功能性測試等。
blocks.en: Many QA staff at pharmaceutical companies are familiar only with Part 211 and mistakenly believe that complying with drug CGMP is enough. During an FDA inspection, investigators also assess Part 820 compliance for the device constituent part, including design controls, needle safety features (if applicable), and functional testing.

blocks.zh: 合規要求摘要： 預填充式注射器製造商必須同時持有藥品 NDA/ANDA 和器材 QS/QMSR 合規文件，或依 §4.4 申請整合合規路徑。
blocks.en: Summary of compliance requirements: a prefilled syringe manufacturer must hold both the drug NDA/ANDA and device QS/QMSR compliance documentation, or apply for an integrated compliance path under §4.4.

blocks.zh: §4.4 整合式 CGMP 路徑（Streamlined Compliance）
blocks.en: §4.4 Integrated CGMP Path (Streamlined Compliance)

blocks.zh: §4.4 提供了一種「減輕負擔」的合規選項：若製造商能夠證明遵守「主要」CGMP 體系的同時，已實質上滿足「次要」CGMP 體系的要求，則可採用整合路徑。
blocks.en: §4.4 provides a "burden-reducing" compliance option: if a manufacturer can demonstrate that, by complying with the "primary" CGMP system, it has also substantially satisfied the requirements of the "secondary" CGMP system, it may use the integrated path.

blocks.zh: 例：藥物洗脫支架（PMOA = 器材）→
blocks.en: Example: drug-eluting stent (PMOA = device) →

blocks.zh: 主要：Part 820（QMSR）
blocks.en: Primary: Part 820 (QMSR)

blocks.zh: 申請整合：在 Part 820 框架下，展示藥品成分的品質管控等同於 Part 211 要求
blocks.en: Applying for integration: under the Part 820 framework, demonstrate that the quality controls for the drug constituent part are equivalent to the Part 211 requirements

blocks.zh: 注意：整合路徑需要事先獲得 Lead Center 同意，不是製造商單方面決定的。
blocks.en: Note: the integrated path requires prior agreement from the Lead Center; it is not something the manufacturer decides unilaterally.

blocks.zh: 應用場景：CDMO 代工預填充式 mAb 注射器
blocks.en: Application Scenario: CDMO Manufacturing a Prefilled mAb Autoinjector

blocks.zh: 情境： 你是一家 CDMO，受客戶委託生產一款含 mAb（單株抗體）的自動注射器（autoinjector）。客戶持有 BLA，你負責灌裝、組裝、最終 QC。
blocks.en: Scenario: You are a CDMO commissioned by a client to produce an autoinjector containing an mAb (monoclonal antibody). The client holds the BLA, and you are responsible for filling, assembly, and final QC.

blocks.zh: 組成成分分析：
blocks.en: Constituent part analysis:

blocks.zh: mAb = 生物製品（biological product）→ 21 CFR Parts 600s + 211
blocks.en: mAb = biological product → 21 CFR Parts 600s + 211

blocks.zh: 自動注射器機構 = 器材 → 21 CFR Part 820
blocks.en: Autoinjector mechanism = device → 21 CFR Part 820

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 CGMP 義務（全部三套同時適用）：
blocks.en: The CDMO's CGMP obligations (all three sets apply at the same time):

blocks.zh: Part 211：灌裝環境管控、批次記錄、放行測試
blocks.en: Part 211: filling environment control, batch records, release testing

blocks.zh: Part 600s：生物製品特有要求（效力測試、病毒安全性等）
blocks.en: Part 600s: requirements specific to biological products (potency testing, viral safety, etc.)

blocks.zh: Part 820：注射器設計驗證、器材功能性測試、器材歷史記錄（DHR）
blocks.en: Part 820: syringe design verification, device functional testing, Device History Record (DHR)

blocks.zh: 合約要點： CDMO 合約必須明確規定哪方（CDMO vs. 藥廠客戶）負責哪套 CGMP 的合規文件，以及 FDA 查廠時各方的配合義務。
blocks.en: Key contract points: the CDMO contract must state clearly which party (the CDMO or the pharmaceutical client) is responsible for the compliance documentation of each CGMP set, and each party's obligation to cooperate during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: 1.4 Constituent Part Analysis — Decision Table（組成成分分析決策表）
blocks.en: 1.4 Constituent Part Analysis — Decision Table

blocks.zh: 組成成分與 CGMP 矩陣 Constituent Part & CGMP Matrix
blocks.en: Constituent Part & CGMP Matrix

blocks.zh: PMOA = Primary Mode of Action（主要作用模式）。Primary CGMP = lead center 的主要 CGMP；Secondary CGMP = 仍須遵守，但可申請整合路徑（§4.4）。
blocks.en: PMOA = Primary Mode of Action. Primary CGMP = the lead center's primary CGMP; Secondary CGMP = must still be followed, but an integrated path may be requested (§4.4).

blocks.zh: 決策邏輯解析 Decision Logic
blocks.en: Decision Logic

blocks.zh: 判斷 CGMP 適用性的三步驟
blocks.en: Three Steps to Determine CGMP Applicability

blocks.zh: 列出所有 Constituent Parts： 逐一識別藥品、器材、生物製品成分
blocks.en: List all constituent parts: identify each drug, device, and biological product constituent part one by one

blocks.zh: 查表對應 CGMP： 每種成分對應其 CGMP 法規（藥→211，器→820，生→600s）
blocks.en: Look up the corresponding CGMP in the table: map each constituent part to its CGMP regulation (drug → 211, device → 820, biological → 600s)

blocks.zh: 確認是否申請整合路徑： 與 Lead Center 協商 §4.4 整合合規，否則須同時滿足所有適用 CGMP
blocks.en: Decide whether to apply for the integrated path: negotiate §4.4 integrated compliance with the Lead Center; otherwise all applicable CGMP must be met

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：CGMP 像建築法規
blocks.en: Analogy: CGMP Is Like Building Codes

blocks.zh: 想像一棟「商住混合大樓」：
blocks.en: Imagine a "mixed-use residential and commercial building":

blocks.zh: 住宅部分 → 必須符合住宅建築法規
blocks.en: Residential part → must meet residential building codes

blocks.zh: 商業部分 → 必須符合商業建築法規
blocks.en: Commercial part → must meet commercial building codes

blocks.zh: 餐廳部分 → 還要加上食品衛生法規
blocks.en: Restaurant part → food hygiene regulations also apply

blocks.zh: 你不能說「主要是住宅，所以商業法規不重要」——每種用途都有其對應的強制要求。組合產品的 CGMP 也一樣：每個 constituent part 都帶來它自己的法規義務。
blocks.en: You cannot say "it is mainly residential, so the commercial codes do not matter"; every use has its own mandatory requirements. CGMP for combination products works the same way: each constituent part brings its own regulatory obligations.

blocks.zh: 基因療法的特殊複雜性
blocks.en: Special Complexity of Gene Therapy

blocks.zh: 基因治療用病毒載體（如 AAV）搭配給藥器材是最複雜的組合產品案例：
blocks.en: A viral vector for gene therapy (such as AAV) combined with a delivery device is the most complex type of combination product:

blocks.zh: 病毒載體 = 生物製品（Parts 600s）+ 含基因操作藥品特性（Parts 210/211）
blocks.en: Viral vector = biological product (Parts 600s) + drug characteristics involving genetic manipulation (Parts 210/211)

blocks.zh: 給藥器材（如顱內注射器）= Part 820
blocks.en: Delivery device (such as an intracranial injection device) = Part 820

blocks.zh: 所有三套 CGMP 均適用
blocks.en: All three sets of CGMP apply

blocks.zh: CBER 通常為主管中心（PMOA 為生物/基因治療機制），但 CDRH 和 CDER 均會參與審查。這類產品幾乎必須透過 OCP 提前尋求指引。
blocks.en: CBER is usually the lead center (the PMOA is the biological/gene therapy mechanism), but CDRH and CDER will both take part in the review. For this type of product, seeking guidance from OCP early is almost essential.

blocks.zh: 練習分類 Classify These Products
blocks.en: Classify These Products

blocks.zh: 請判斷下列各產品的組成成分類型與適用 CGMP：
blocks.en: Determine the constituent part types and applicable CGMP for each of the following products:

blocks.zh: 含肝素（heparin）的透析導管（heparin-coated dialysis catheter）
blocks.en: A dialysis catheter containing heparin (heparin-coated dialysis catheter)

blocks.zh: 帶有皮下葡萄糖感測器的胰島素幫浦系統（insulin pump + CGM）
blocks.en: An insulin pump system with a subcutaneous glucose sensor (insulin pump + CGM)

blocks.zh: 骨科手術中使用的抗生素骨水泥（antibiotic bone cement）
blocks.en: Antibiotic bone cement used in orthopedic surgery (antibiotic bone cement)

blocks.zh: 含細菌疫苗成分的奈米顆粒注射劑
blocks.en: A nanoparticle injectable containing a bacterial vaccine component

Reference answers: (1) drug + device → 211 + 820; (2) drug + device → 211 + 820 (separate applications or co-packaged? the relationship must be confirmed); (3) drug + device → 211 + 820; (4) biological + drug + device → 600s + 211, possibly + 820.

blocks.zh: 1.5 Comparison: Regulated as Drug vs. Device vs. Biological（三大監管路徑比較）
blocks.en: 1.5 Comparison: Regulated as Drug vs. Device vs. Biological

blocks.zh: 三大主管中心監管要求比較 Regulatory Requirements by Lead Center
blocks.en: Regulatory Requirements by Lead Center

blocks.zh: 三個中心的核心文化差異
blocks.en: Core Cultural Differences Among the Three Centers

blocks.zh: 了解三個中心的「思維框架」有助於理解為何組合產品監管如此複雜：
blocks.en: Understanding the "mindset" of each of the three centers helps explain why combination product regulation is so complex:

blocks.zh: CDER 的藥品思維： 關注「成分的化學一致性」——每批次的化學純度、含量、雜質必須在規格內，批次記錄為核心文件
blocks.en: CDER's drug mindset: focuses on "chemical consistency of the composition": chemical purity, content, and impurities of each batch must be within specification, and the batch record is the core document

blocks.zh: CDRH 的器材思維： 關注「設計的安全有效性」——產品設計是否經過充分驗證？每台器材的製造歷史是否可追溯？CAPA 系統是否健全？
blocks.en: CDRH's device mindset: focuses on "safety and effectiveness of the design": has the product design been adequately validated? Is the manufacturing history of each device traceable? Is the CAPA system sound?

blocks.zh: CBER 的生物製品思維： 關注「生物活性的可靠性與安全性」——效力是否一致？病毒安全性如何確保？免疫原性是否符合預期？
blocks.en: CBER's biological product mindset: focuses on "reliability and safety of biological activity": is potency consistent? How is viral safety ensured? Is immunogenicity as expected?

blocks.zh: 三種思維框架在組合產品中必須同時並存——這正是組合產品監管最具挑戰性的地方。
blocks.en: All three mindsets must coexist in a combination product, which is exactly what makes combination product regulation the most challenging.

blocks.zh: MDR vs. FAERS vs. VAERS — 不同的上市後報告系統
blocks.en: MDR vs. FAERS vs. VAERS: Different Postmarket Reporting Systems

blocks.zh: 組合產品的上市後不良事件報告取決於 Lead Center：
blocks.en: Postmarket adverse event reporting for a combination product depends on the Lead Center:

blocks.zh: FAERS（FDA Adverse Event Reporting System）： 藥品不良事件，由醫療人員和廠商提交，MedWatch 3500/3500A 表格
blocks.en: FAERS (FDA Adverse Event Reporting System): drug adverse events, submitted by healthcare professionals and manufacturers, using MedWatch Forms 3500/3500A

blocks.zh: MDR（Medical Device Reporting）： 器材不良事件，強制性報告，含死亡（30天）、嚴重傷害（30天）、故障（30天）；MAUDE 資料庫公開查詢
blocks.en: MDR (Medical Device Reporting): device adverse events, mandatory reporting, covering deaths (30 days), serious injuries (30 days), and malfunctions (30 days); the MAUDE database is publicly searchable

blocks.zh: VAERS（Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System）： 疫苗不良事件，CBER 主管；也接受部分其他生物製品
blocks.en: VAERS (Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System): vaccine adverse events, administered by CBER; it also accepts reports for some other biological products

blocks.zh: 對於組合產品，Lead Center 決定主要報告系統，但實際上可能需要向多個系統提報。
blocks.en: For a combination product, the Lead Center determines the primary reporting system, but in practice reports may need to be submitted to several systems.

blocks.zh: 510(k) vs. PMA vs. NDA vs. BLA — 核准路徑速覽
blocks.en: 510(k) vs. PMA vs. NDA vs. BLA: Approval Pathways at a Glance

blocks.zh: 器材端（CDRH）：
blocks.en: Device side (CDRH):

blocks.zh: 510(k) — 實質等效性（Substantial Equivalence）： Class II 器材，引用已上市的「predicate device」，通常 90–180 天
blocks.en: 510(k): Substantial Equivalence: Class II devices, citing a marketed "predicate device", typically 90-180 days

blocks.zh: PMA — 上市前核准（Premarket Approval）： Class III 高風險器材，需完整臨床數據，通常 180 天以上
blocks.en: PMA: Premarket Approval: Class III high-risk devices, requiring full clinical data, typically 180 days or more

blocks.zh: De Novo： 無 predicate 的中風險新型器材，建立新的分類
blocks.en: De Novo: novel moderate-risk devices with no predicate, establishing a new classification

blocks.zh: 藥品端（CDER）：
blocks.en: Drug side (CDER):

blocks.zh: NDA — New Drug Application： 新藥，需完整 Phase I/II/III 數據
blocks.en: NDA: New Drug Application: new drugs, requiring full Phase I/II/III data

blocks.zh: ANDA — 學名藥申請： 引用 RLD，證明生體相等性
blocks.en: ANDA: Abbreviated New Drug Application (generic drugs): cites the RLD and demonstrates bioequivalence

blocks.zh: 505(b)(2)： 引用已有數據的「混合型」NDA，常用於組合產品
blocks.en: 505(b)(2): a "hybrid" NDA that relies on existing data, often used for combination products

blocks.zh: 生物製品端（CBER）：
blocks.en: Biological product side (CBER):

blocks.zh: BLA — Biologics License Application： 生物製品的核准申請，351(a) 為原廠，351(k) 為生物相似藥
blocks.en: BLA: Biologics License Application: application for approval of a biological product; 351(a) is for the originator product and 351(k) is for biosimilars

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：三個中心像三個不同的政府部門
blocks.en: Analogy: The Three Centers Are Like Three Different Government Departments

blocks.zh: 想像你開了一家「自動販賣藥丸的機器人藥局」：
blocks.en: Imagine you have opened a "robotic pharmacy that dispenses pills from a vending machine":

blocks.zh: 藥品管理局（CDER） 要看：藥丸的成分是否純淨、有效期標示、製造記錄
blocks.en: The drug authority (CDER) wants to see: whether the pill ingredients are pure, the expiry dating, and the manufacturing records

blocks.zh: 器材管理局（CDRH） 要看：機器人的設計是否安全、給藥機構是否經過驗證、有無傷人風險
blocks.en: The device authority (CDRH) wants to see: whether the robot's design is safe, whether the dispensing mechanism has been validated, and whether there is any risk of injury

blocks.zh: 生物製品管理局（CBER） 若藥丸含蛋白質生物製品：還要看效力、病毒安全性
blocks.en: The biological product authority (CBER), if the pill contains a protein biological product, also wants to see: potency and viral safety

blocks.zh: 三個部門的關切點不同，但你必須全部滿足——這就是為什麼組合產品廠商必須同時熟悉三套 CGMP 語言。
blocks.en: The three departments have different concerns, but you must satisfy all of them. This is why combination product manufacturers must be fluent in all three CGMP "languages".

blocks.zh: 本節摘要 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 4 §§ 4.1–4.3 核心要點 Key Takeaways
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 4 §§4.1-4.3 Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: §4.1 — 範圍
blocks.en: §4.1: Scope

blocks.zh: Part 4 適用於 §3.2(e) 定義的組合產品
blocks.en: Part 4 applies to combination products as defined in §3.2(e)

blocks.zh: 僅受 PHS Act 管轄的純生物製品不適用
blocks.en: Purely biological products regulated only under the PHS Act are not covered

blocks.zh: 功能：指派主管中心 + 釐清 CGMP 義務
blocks.en: Function: assign the lead center + clarify CGMP obligations

blocks.zh: §4.2 — 定義
blocks.en: §4.2: Definitions

blocks.zh: 組合產品四類型：單一實體、共包裝、交叉標示、試驗性
blocks.en: Four types of combination product: single-entity, co-packaged, cross-labeled, investigational

blocks.zh: PMOA 決定 Lead Center（CDER/CDRH/CBER）
blocks.en: PMOA determines the Lead Center (CDER/CDRH/CBER)

blocks.zh: OCP（設於 Commissioner 辦公室）負責指派
blocks.en: OCP (located in the Commissioner's Office) is responsible for assignment

blocks.zh: §4.3 — 適用 CGMP
blocks.en: §4.3: Applicable CGMP

blocks.zh: 藥品成分 → Parts 210/211；器材成分 → Part 820；生物製品 → Parts 600s
blocks.en: Drug constituent part → Parts 210/211; device constituent part → Part 820; biological product → Parts 600s

blocks.zh: 多種成分 = 多套 CGMP 同時適用
blocks.en: Multiple constituent parts = multiple sets of CGMP apply at the same time

blocks.zh: §4.4 整合路徑可減輕雙重合規負擔（需先獲核准）
blocks.en: The §4.4 integrated path can reduce the burden of dual compliance (prior approval required)

blocks.zh: 三大中心比較
blocks.en: Comparison of the Three Centers

blocks.zh: 核准路徑：NDA / PMA(510k) / BLA
blocks.en: Approval pathways: NDA / PMA (510(k)) / BLA

blocks.zh: 上市後報告：FAERS / MDR(MAUDE) / VAERS
blocks.en: Postmarket reporting: FAERS / MDR (MAUDE) / VAERS

blocks.zh: Lead Center 思維框架決定查廠重點
blocks.en: The Lead Center's mindset determines the inspection focus

blocks.zh: 最重要的一句話： 組合產品的 CGMP 義務由組成成分決定，不由主要作用模式決定。PMOA 只決定哪個中心「主導」；但只要含有某種成分，該成分對應的 CGMP 就全部適用，無論是主要還是次要成分。
blocks.en: The single most important sentence: the CGMP obligations of a combination product are determined by its constituent parts, not by its primary mode of action. PMOA only determines which center "leads"; as long as a given constituent part is present, all of the CGMP corresponding to that constituent part apply, whether it is the primary or a secondary constituent part.
